card.name: Spots just before a citation or number
card.fires_on: Punctuation, spaces and small words right before a number, date or citation detail, such as the space before a serum level range or the comma before a date. It also fires on sentence-final periods in web text.

modes.label: Space before a range
modes.description: The space just before a numeric level range, such as therapeutic serum concentrations.

modes.label: Date or reference slot
modes.description: A word or mark right before a year, month or date in a citation or page footer.

modes.label: Sentence-end period
modes.description: A period ending a sentence in web prose, before a list item.

card.plain: It marks the small gap just before a number, date or reference detail and steers away from the word source.
